note: Golden Valley County (ND) has a 2012 zoning ordinance and Beach has its own, but both say the official district map is kept on file at the auditor's office. The county's only GIS is the 'Look Up GIS Maps' ArcGIS Experience viewer, whose layers could not be identified as zoning; no zoning district polygon service (county or city, ArcGIS Hub/Online or ND GIS Hub) was found in searches. Only PDF/paper zoning maps are published.
